grade_note: runtime observation on one vehicle and one night; not a firmware claim and not generalisable to other head units
claim_in_one_line: when the head unit still holds a previous session it answers nothing at all, not even the iAP link ACK, and it releases the session by itself later

environment.phone: iPhone 18,1 identity profile, iOS 27.0.1 / 24A446 baseline used for the declaration checks
environment.transport: Bluetooth RFCOMM, outbound from the phone
environment.raw_log_reason: logcat contains the device address and network identifiers, and the full capture is tens of MB

paired_sessions.why_paired: same night, same app build, same phone, same declaration; only the head unit state differed

session_a_accepted.note: the log line at the tail of IapLink.send(), emitted only after every tx slot is acknowledged

session_b_silent.meaning: the bytes went out and nothing came back at the link layer; this is not a rejected 5702, it is a silent link

declaration_is_identical.implication: the {5702 send, 5703 receive} gate from spec/91 3 is satisfied in both sessions, so the gate is not the variable
declaration_is_identical.rules_out: the tempting conclusion that the car never declared 0x5702

recovery_sequence.outcome: stopped at stage BLUETOOTH, never reached DETECT

contrast_not_upstream.what: a work branch outside this repository resent 0x5702 every 5s up to 6 frames inside a 25s budget
contrast_not_upstream.observed: on the same car, that round ended with the head unit power-cycling
contrast_not_upstream.grade: OBSERVED, single vehicle, single night, no control run
contrast_not_upstream.use: supports 'fewer frames while the car is stuck'; it is not evidence about the firmware and not a law

implementation_gap.code: Bootstrap.kt:112 ANNOUNCEMENT_WAIT_MS = 30_000; Bootstrap.kt:334 require(handoffWaitMs in 1..30_000L); Bootstrap.kt:477 break; Bootstrap.kt:498 throw HANDOFF_FAILED
implementation_gap.consequence: no single attempt can wait longer than 30s, while this car took about 66s to release
implementation_gap.what_it_does_not_mean: it does not mean 30 should become 70; that would swap one constant with no firmware counterpart for another
implementation_gap.what_it_does_mean: recovery cannot come from a longer wait inside one attempt; it has to come from not asking again inside the hold window

local_mitigation_not_recommended_upstrea.what: 20070 persists the moment the car refused and withholds 0x5702 for 45s
local_mitigation_not_recommended_upstrea.why_not_recommended: 45s is a local value chosen from this observation, not a firmware value; it is a concrete stand-in for 'do not ask inside the window' until WS-OPEN-04 or head-unit evidence exists

not_claimed: the head unit does not have a 66s or a 45s timeout - that is one observation, not a mechanism
other head units may behave differently (reject, 1D03, drop the link); none of that was observed
resending does not provably cause the power cycle - sample size 1, no control run
the release path itself stays WS-OPEN-01
reproduction_filter: adb logcat -v time | grep -E "iAP frame TX|csm=5702|iAP TX 5702|stage (WIFI|PAIR|SETUP|DETECT|AUTH)|Identify accessorySends|failure"
